content: Trust/rejection data 2026: AIDev-dataset study (arXiv 2606.13468) finds 46.41% of agentic PR fixes (Copilot/Devin/Cursor/Claude) are rejected. Categories: relevance 23.5% (inactivity 17.3%, superseded 5.9%), implementation problems 11.3% (incorrect fix 5.6%, wrong approach 2.6%), technical failures 7.2% (CI failures 6.9%), provider issues 8.5% (agent failure/unreachable 7.5%). Only ~36% of maintainer rejections were clear code failures; 31% were workflow-constraint rejections (right change, wrong time/groundwork). ~17M agent PRs/month on GitHub as of Mar 2026 (up 325% in 6 months); GitHub added kill switches letting maintainers disable PRs or restrict to collaborators. Only ~3% of devs highly trust AI code; 38% say reviewing AI code takes more effort than human code. Paper's design implications: pre-task filtering/dedup, embedded project-specific guidance on preferred and forbidden approaches, give agents CI requirements and test specs, robust provider error handling.
